summary: Vernon Parish lookout listed by Central US Lookouts; the only details there are its name, parish and a location code.

evidence.supports: Hicks is an unincorporated community in Vernon Parish
evidence.quote: Hicks is an unincorporated community in Vernon Parish, Louisiana, United States.
A post office called Hicks was established in 1887 and remained in operation until it was discontinued in 1992.

corrections.why: The lookout page gives a location code, 3N-6W-Sec.10, not an agency.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Central US Lookouts index says Vernon County; the lookout page and Wikipedia say Vernon Parish. The record's county value Vernon is consistent with the parish.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The lookout page gives only the name, the parish and the location code; no build date, staffing, agency, or status was found in any source read. The record's location (31.1722, -92.9666) comes from the map embed on the lookout page, not from its text, so it is not quoted here. The Central US Lookouts site also has a hicks.html page for a different tower, HICKS (ELO) in Hardin County (Shawnee National Forest, Illinois); keep the two apart. The lookout page carries one photograph (https://centraluslookouts.weebly.com/uploads/1/5/9/1/1591048/3010051_orig.jpg, alt text 'Picture'); its licence is unknown, so it is not added to photos. The story quotes the code 3N-6W-Sec.10 unexpanded; no source read explains it.
